title: Negotiate a Friday Release
student_brief: Your stakeholder wants additional features before Friday. Clarify their needs and negotiate a realistic release plan.

character.name: Alex
character.personality: Direct and deadline-focused, but willing to consider well-explained trade-offs.
character.goal: Deliver a successful customer demonstration on Friday.

opening_message: We need analytics and CSV export added before Friday. Can your team commit to both?

discoverable_information.fact: The core customer workflow is essential for Friday's demonstration.
discoverable_information.reveal_when: The student asks about the demonstration or business priorities.

discoverable_information.fact: Analytics and CSV export can be delivered after the demonstration.
discoverable_information.reveal_when: The student asks about phased delivery or negotiable requirements.
